description: This file defines a static class AssetChildFlows that contains numerous asynchronous methods for managing various aspects of assets and their related entities in a data asset management system. The methods include creating, listing, getting, updating, and validating relationships for asset status logs, additional asset IDs, properties, control device mappings, input parameters, parent input mappings, reporting attribute mappings, EF source mappings, throughput equations, throughput scalars, data input values, and their associated checks like existence, hierarchy cycles, and duplicates.

classes.name: AssetChildFlows
classes.description: A static class providing a comprehensive set of asynchronous methods for managing asset-related data and relationships, including validations and hierarchy integrity checks. It acts as the application's API layer for asset operations.

methods.name: CreateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Creates a new asset status log entry for a specified asset after validation and chronological checks.

methods.name: ListAssetStatusLogsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of status logs for a specified asset.

methods.name: GetAssetStatusLogByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific status log entry for an asset by its ID, ensuring the log belongs to the asset.

methods.name: UpdateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Updates a specific status log for an asset, with validation on chronology.

methods.name: CreateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Creates a record for an additional asset ID under a specified asset.

methods.name: ListAdditionalAssetIdsAsync
methods.description: Lists all additional asset IDs associated with a specific asset.

methods.name: GetAdditionalAssetIdByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific additional asset ID record by ID.

methods.name: UpdateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing additional asset ID record.

methods.name: CreateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Creates a new property record for an asset.

methods.name: ListAssetPropertiesAsync
methods.description: Lists all properties for a given asset.

methods.name: GetAssetPropertyByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property of an asset by ID.

methods.name: UpdateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Updates a specific property of an asset.

methods.name: CreateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a mapping between an asset and a control device.

methods.name: ListControlDeviceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists all control device mappings for an asset.

methods.name: GetControlDeviceMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific control device mapping by ID.

methods.name: UpdateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a control device mapping for an asset.

methods.name: CreateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Creates a new input parameter for an asset.

methods.name: ListInputParametersAsync
methods.description: Lists all input parameters for an asset.

methods.name: GetInputParameterByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific input parameter by ID.

methods.name: UpdateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing input parameter.

methods.name: CreateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a parent input mapping for a given child input parameter, validating hierarchy and cycles.

methods.name: ListParentInputMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists parent input mappings for a child input parameter.

methods.name: UpdateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a parent input mapping, ensuring no cycles or invalid hierarchy.

methods.name: CreateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a mapping for reporting attributes under an asset, ensuring uniqueness within the asset.

methods.name: ListReportingAttributeMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists reporting attribute mappings for an asset.

methods.name: GetReportingAttributeMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reporting attribute mapping.

methods.name: UpdateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a reporting attribute mapping, checking for duplicate attribute combinations.

methods.name: CreateEfSourceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates an EF source mapping for an input parameter, validating asset and input parameter scope.

methods.name: ListEfSourceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists EF source mappings for an input parameter.

methods.name: GetEfSourceMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EF source mapping.

methods.name: UpdateEfSourceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates an EF source mapping.

methods.name: CreateThroughputEquationAsync
methods.description: Creates a throughput equation associated with an input parameter.

methods.name: ListThroughputEquationsAsync
methods.description: Lists throughput equations for an input parameter.

methods.name: GetThroughputEquationByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific throughput equation.

methods.name: UpdateThroughputEquationAsync
methods.description: Updates a throughput equation.

methods.name: CreateThroughputScalarAsync
methods.description: Creates a throughput scalar linked to a throughput equation, validating scope.

methods.name: ListThroughputScalarsAsync
methods.description: Lists throughput scalars for an equation.

methods.name: GetThroughputScalarByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific throughput scalar.

methods.name: UpdateThroughputScalarAsync
methods.description: Updates a throughput scalar.

methods.name: CreateDataInputValueAsync
methods.description: Creates a data input value under an asset for a given input parameter.

methods.name: ListDataInputValuesAsync
methods.description: Lists data input values for an input parameter.

methods.name: GetDataInputValueByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific data input value.

methods.name: UpdateDataInputValueAsync
methods.description: Updates a data input value.
